description: Mike directive 2026-05-17: verify the cold-network-until-agent contract. (1) on boot WITHOUT an agent, presenceInit / p2pInit / voiceInit / groupSessionInit / chatInit are NEVER called -- no UDP socket is bound, no identity is announced. The PRESENCE: socket bound line that previously fired at boot is forbidden. (2) on --launch-load-agent, socialRebindToActiveAgent re-derives (pubkey || agent_name) handle/code, then socialHubBringOnline() runs the deferred online inits (under --no-net it logs 'socialHubBringOnline() skipped' instead of binding sockets), then presenceMarkAgentLoaded flips the state. The --no-net path is what the smoke harness uses to keep the firewall focus-steal class out of the test; the live-net path is exercised by the runtime CS room flows.

input_sequence.comment: boot + agent-load + mission transition is fully scripted via CLI fast-paths; no menu input needed.
scripted exit after presence states have flipped through bootstrap -> online -> in-match.

required_lines: PRESENCE: agent loaded -- state=(online|in-match), social hub activity enabled
